purpose: Optional targeted questions shown after a participant independently reports that something important is missing and selects a PRECEPTA pattern that requires information not directly represented by the 26 static scores.
bias_control: Ask whether something important is missing before showing uninferred patterns.
Do not use a follow-up answer to rewrite the result already shown in the same session.
Store follow-up responses as separate model-development observations.
Use structured responses rather than free text in the initial research phase.

questions.prompt: I often understand something before I can explain the steps by which I reached the understanding.
questions.reason: The 26 items do not directly measure insight-to-explanation latency.

questions.prompt: Starting work is substantially easier inside a domain that matters deeply to me than outside it.
questions.reason: The 26 items do not separately measure Entry Threshold inside and outside an aligned domain.

questions.prompt: Work becomes markedly easier to start when I can see why it matters.
questions.reason: The defining ET shift by perceived meaning is dynamic.

questions.prompt: A real approaching deadline can suddenly make a task much easier for me to start.
questions.reason: The defining high-to-low ET transition near deadline is not directly measured.

questions.prompt: I repeatedly cycle between strong engagement and disengagement when I have exceeded my recovery capacity.
questions.reason: The static profile can suggest recovery limits but not repeated temporal cycling.

questions.prompt: When I am engaged or excited, I sometimes speak before I have fully filtered what I want to say.
questions.reason: The 26 dimensions do not directly measure output inhibition or conversational interruption.

questions.prompt: I can appear socially fine while consciously managing my behavior and paying for it afterward.
questions.reason: The architecture can suggest hidden social cost but not conscious masking itself.

questions.prompt: I find it difficult not to correct or challenge something when truth, fairness, or responsibility is at stake.
questions.reason: The 26 dimensions measure precision and internal standards, not specifically ethical content.

questions.prompt: Emotional load can build until it suddenly becomes much harder for me to regulate or stay engaged.
questions.reason: Threshold-crossing affective overwhelm is a dynamic phenomenon.

questions.prompt: Perceived unfairness or moral inconsistency can stay active in my mind and demand a response.
questions.reason: The source explicitly requires a values-specific form of conceptual integration.

questions.prompt: Movement, music, or other sensory input can help me stabilize attention or energy.
questions.reason: The 26 items do not directly measure active sensory-seeking behavior.

questions.prompt: I use repetitive movement or sensory actions to help regulate concentration, tension, or energy.
questions.reason: The regulatory behavior itself is not directly measured.

questions.prompt: I often misjudge how much time has passed or how long a task will take until an external cue makes it concrete.
questions.reason: Subjective duration estimation is not the same construct as Temporal Depth.
